counties.name: Adams County
counties.readerDecision: Choose a virtual museum visit, arranged physical visit or the correct clinic contact.

The researched local facts change names and hours but do not support a sufficiently distinct commissioned project beyond those complete records.

counties.name: Barnes County
counties.readerDecision: Choose staffed visitor-center help or a self-guided audio route.
counties.rationale: Box Butte already gives detailed self-guided-map project preparation, including access constraints; Atchison distinguishes self-directed digital and live/onsite experiences. No additional Barnes-specific operating decision justified a new service or guide.

counties.name: Benson County

Sherman distinguishes seasonal application from overnight booking; Stewart distinguishes storage from occupied RVs; neither combines all three entitlements within one operator’s product comparison.

counties.name: Billings County
counties.readerDecision: Give pass holders, voucher holders and groups the right ticket route.
counties.rationale: Adds entitlement-specific pre-checkout routing alongside group itinerary triage. Ford covers guided group access and Dodge sale status; the timed-booking guide explains pass-versus-reservation broadly but not this multi-route commissioning and maintenance work.

counties.name: Bottineau County
counties.readerDecision: Show access, equipment and instruction as separate choices.
counties.rationale: Adds cross-product age-band comparison and an acceptance case where free admission does not imply free gear. Johnson focuses on swim placement and Marshall on class versus studio access; this project concerns independently priced components of one visit.

counties.name: Bowman County

counties.rationale: Combines honest seasonal availability with a two-location educational day and personal-vehicle responsibility. Nemaha covers a suspended cruise; the additional scope here preserves a field/museum itinerary and explicitly prevents annual rollover from reopening registration.

counties.name: Burke County
counties.readerDecision: Compare verified campsite utilities and contact the selected operator.
counties.rationale: Watonwan already separates amenities and facilities; Dixon and Lac Qui Parle cover first-come camping versus reservations. The county list supports accurate comparison but lacks enough operator-specific process to add substantial project guidance beyond those records. Unpublished utilities are not treated as absent.

counties.name: Burleigh County
counties.readerDecision: Ask how an event changes through the day before quoting the room.
counties.rationale: Adds a time sequence to room selection: initial setup versus later changeover, equipment versus operating labor and generic connectivity versus a specific technical requirement. Webster and Craig cover room/catering responsibilities and configurations, but not this combined run-of-day inquiry.

counties.name: Cass County
counties.readerDecision: Explain which membership step serves a class and which enables studio use.

Polk and Hennepin cover studio approval and access; Marshall covers lesson versus studio choice, but not the membership-before-discounted-checkout sequence beside a separate studio enrollment path.

counties.name: Cavalier County
counties.readerDecision: Match the cleaning request to the available process and location.
counties.rationale: Adds process-level routing across fixed and portable equipment, rather than generic branch selection. Gove distinguishes elevator/shop routes and Grant distinguishes known orders from advice; this brief preserves the required processing capability as the handoff criterion.

counties.name: Dickey County
counties.readerDecision: Show the service schedule that changes with a longer stay.
counties.rationale: Adds recurring service cadence to accommodation selection. Swift covers length-related contact, Wayne property amenities and Roane payment versus lease duration; the distinct acceptance case is a monthly choice that changes cleaning frequency.

counties.name: Divide County

counties.name: Dunn County

counties.rationale: Adds the distinction between a transcribed narrative and the original voice, retaining item identity across media and pre-production confirmation. Lane distinguishes copy formats and outsourced production; Butler research scope. This project connects two substantive representations of one interview without becoming a genealogy intake.

counties.name: Eddy County

Logan OK addresses exchanges/late arrival; Dodge MN addresses production sales state/payment location. Neither supplies this message-to-purchase commissioning brief.

counties.name: Emmons County

counties.name: Golden Valley County

counties.rationale: Chatham NC compares sale, showroom and item availability; Marshall IN compares teaching formats. The local whole project instead separates staff-dependent observation, ordinary shopping and a maker-reviewed set discussion without inventing lessons or guaranteed access.

counties.name: Grand Forks County
counties.readerDecision: Plan the room change before promising the event schedule.
counties.rationale: Anoka concerns final group count and Howard private ceremony/reception time. This page makes room-reset time part of the initial agenda and connects that agenda to staged inputs and contact ownership. A two-hour gap test shows the concrete design purpose.

counties.name: Grant County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the reservation route from the intended arrival date.
counties.rationale: Dixon and Osceola separate first-come/reservable campgrounds. Lake Tschida adds a time-dependent change of route for the same intended stay and a campsite/cabin arrival distinction. The three-day-ahead check is substantive and does not infer vacancy.

counties.name: Griggs County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the experience before choosing a destination.
counties.rationale: Edwards TX distinguishes surface viewing from a cavern and Crawford IN tour time. This local project compares two locations under one attraction name, identifies what can actually be entered and retains location-specific preparation rather than using one generic map.

counties.name: Hettinger County

The sources do not establish a distinct owner-specific package or workflow sufficient to add another page without extrapolating.

counties.name: Kidder County

counties.name: LaMoure County

counties.rationale: LeSueur handles permitted rental building and public-park boundaries, and Osceola separates campground booking routes. This brief adds the organizer’s multipart reunion checklist and tests that a hall arrangement does not imply camping, museum or golf confirmation.

counties.name: Logan County

counties.name: McIntosh County

counties.name: McKenzie County

counties.name: Mercer County

Morton adds a commissioning brief around year-round room hire inside a seasonal visitor setting, plus public versus reserved shelter electrical access; the acceptance test concerns an event agenda rather than ordinary attraction admission.

counties.name: Mountrail County

counties.name: Ramsey County

counties.name: Ransom County

counties.name: Renville County

counties.name: Richland County

It avoids all disputed encounter eligibility claims.

counties.name: Rolette County

counties.name: Sargent County

counties.name: Sheridan County

counties.name: Slope County

counties.rationale: NO_ADDITION: Nebraska/Dixon and Missouri/Barry cover seasonal amenity distinctions; Kansas/Coffey addresses research evidence gaps. The complete local sources do not add a new project mechanism.

The added project centers on the physical transfer of lunches between bus, staff and assigned room, combined with a separately confirmed lunch reservation; the acceptance test follows the actual handoff.

Here the combined commissioning task is to establish an indoor plan independent of first-come overflow, then fit renter furniture work inside staff-controlled access. This is proposed planning guidance, not a new park weather policy.

counties.rationale: NO_ADDITION: Kansas/Crawford and Oklahoma/Marshall already distinguish buildings, departments and contact purposes. The sources do not support a distinct new commissioned feature.

counties.rationale: NO_ADDITION: Minnesota/Washington, Iowa/Dallas and Texas/Wichita already cover museum/event scope, deposit distinctions and complete rental arrangements. Different amounts or capacity do not add a new reader decision.

counties.name: Campbell County

counties.rationale: NO_ADDITION: Minnesota/Lincoln, Nebraska/Madison and Missouri/Barry cover property choice and seasonal amenity limits. No additional supported commissioning decision emerged.

This local project addresses a custom destination changing the quoted bundle and responsibility for meals/lodging, with a test that a special-request lake never inherits the standard outing’s confirmation.

counties.name: Clark County

It supplies an owner-approved staff-role comparison and a comprehension test instead of merely adding another tour category.

counties.name: Codington County

The new brief combines geographic and institution-type categories with a dated school-year checkpoint, so selecting a free program does not determine admission.

counties.name: Corson County

This page adds owner-controlled mapping across overlapping lodging labels and requires a content review before any product-specific rule is displayed. The ambiguity is a commissioning input, not an invented resolution.

counties.name: Custer County

This brief makes a shared elevator entrance explicitly insufficient to describe the trip and compares the in-cave routes, with a concrete acceptance check for an elevator-only assumption.
